crossRefs.note: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and…
Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which…
“Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service…
In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from Yahweh:
In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

translations.web: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
translations.bsb: He prowled among the lions, and became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
translations.kjv: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
translations.asv: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
